provider: HKU Business School BBA(BA) and BSc(MAT) Syllabuses 2025-26
note: The official 2025-26 syllabuses apply to candidates admitted in 2025-26 and thereafter, subject to approval. Both Programmes publish a closed 96-credit Major comprising 24 Faculty Core credits, 48 Disciplinary Core credits and 24 Disciplinary Elective credits. BBA(BA) requires two electives from Analytics Techniques List A and two from Business Applications List B; up to four approved MSc(BA) substitutions remain outside the published undergraduate pool. BSc(MAT) requires either MKTG3531 or MKTG4501 as its 6-credit capstone, plus two electives from Marketing Technology and Strategy List A and two from Marketing Analytics List B. Language, Common Core, AI literacy, non-credit University requirements and free electives are excluded because they contain open or placeholder course ranges. Courses are not necessarily offered every year.

supplements.ruleSummary: 96 major credits: 24 Faculty Core credits, 48 Disciplinary Core credits including the IIMT4602 capstone, and 24 Disciplinary Elective credits from four courses, comprising two Analytics Techniques List A courses and two Business Applications List B courses.
supplements.evidenceGap: The official syllabus is subject to approval and says courses are not necessarily offered every year. It permits up to four approved MSc(BA) courses as third- or fourth-year disciplinary electives; those approval-based substitutions are not expanded. The statistics choice and the two-from-each-list rule remain manual checks. Open or placeholder-coded University and free-elective requirements are excluded.
